resources.string: All channels are excluded from the feed.
Show the feed as a bottom navigation tab in place of the Contacts tab.
Uncheck a channel to hide its posts from the feed. New channels are shown automatically.
Also include channels from your archived chats in the feed.
Mark all posts in your feed channels as read? This will also mark them as read in the original channels.
New channels you follow appear in the feed automatically.
New channels stay hidden until you check them below.
Categories appear as tabs at the top of the feed. Drag to reorder, tap the eye to hide a tab.
Posts from the selected channels appear when this category is open, even if a channel is hidden from All. A channel can be in several categories.
Delete the category **%1$s**? Its channels will stay in the feed.
Add channels to it, and their posts will appear here.
**%1$s** is hidden. You can show it again in feed settings.
You have edited this category. Save changes?
Hidden channels still appear in their categories.
